title: Unify constraint evaluation into constraints::check::evaluate
description: Extract a pure constraints::check::evaluate(facts, constraints, waivers, scope) -> CheckOutcome that replaces the four independent implementations in review.rs, constraints.rs tool, orient.rs, and guard.rs. Guard keeps its fast raw-SQL fact-gathering as a second adapter at the facts seam but feeds the same core. DD engine management (ingest-or-reload, ephemeral fallback, forbidden-pair loading, cycle query) lives behind the interface. Delta-labeling (remove changed-file edges, re-query, diff) becomes an option of scope=ChangedFiles. One canonical ConstraintFinding type, one waiver partition.
decisions: waiver-match rule: from_path only (the violating import site), not from||to — stricter, consistent with review/constraints tool behavior; guard.rs from||to match is the bug
execution_record: Unified constraint evaluation across 4 call sites into `constraints::check::evaluate`. 9 commits: types (check.rs), DD+Workspace path, ChangedFiles delta labeling, RawConn path, migrate constraints tool, migrate orient, migrate guard, migrate review+bin/guard, clippy cleanup. Net ~-500 lines. All 299+integration tests pass.

messages.author: codex
messages.text:
Codex review: needs-attention. Two findings:

1. [high] Removed forbidden imports cannot be reported as resolved (check.rs:147-168). ChangedFiles baseline never reconstructs deleted edges from old_edges, so resolved violations are silently missed. Fix: compute baseline as (current_edges - added_edges) + removed_old_edges.

2. [medium] Review total now excludes waived constraint violations (review.rs:391-394). constraint_violations_total is set after waiver partition, so it only counts active. Should be active + waived to match pre-refactor contract.
